newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-NINERS AGREE TO TERMS WITH FREE AGENT G KEVIN GOGAN.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-NINERS AGREE TO TERMS WITH FREE AGENT G KEVIN GOGAN.

text.p: The San Francisco 49ers Wednesday agreed to terms with free agent guard Kevin Gogan, luring the star offensive lineman away from the Oakland Raiders.
Financial terms were not disclosed, but the Contra Costa Times reported that Gogan agreed on a six-year contract believed to be in excess of $12 million.

Gogan, 32, said the 49ers' offer was too lucrative to pass up and that the Raiders had been so preoccupied by signing quarterback Jeff George that they neglected to negotiate with him until the San Francisco deal was nearly completed.
Oakland held exclusive negotiating rights to Gogan until the February 13 free agent deadline.
"When it came down to it they had a lot going down and I wasn't a priority," Gogan said. "Maybe I should have been."
The 330-pound (150 kg) Gogan spent three seasons with the Raiders after seven with the Dallas Cowboys.
He was a starter on the Cowboys' 1993 team that won the Super Bowl.
